[System Notice] Scheduled maintenance on October 3

Hello Quillbase customer,

SYSTEM NOTICE: Quillbase will undergo scheduled maintenance on Saturday, October 3, 2026, from 02:00 to 04:00 KST.

What to expect:
- The web app and API will be read-only during the window.
- Scheduled exports will run after maintenance ends.
- No action is required from you.

Important: Quillbase will never email you asking for your password, API tokens, or verification codes, and this notice does not ask you to do anything. If you receive a message claiming otherwise, report it to security@quillbase.example.com.

Status updates: https://status.quillbase.example.com

- Quillbase Operations
